title: Patient Payment Plans Installment Agreement: Signature, Proposal Validity and Activation
content:
The following conditions govern how a plan under the Patient Payment Plans comes into force.

**1. Signature by the patient.** A plan takes effect only when the patient signs the installment agreement. Accepting a payment obligation is the patient's own act and is never done for them.

**2. Time allowed to sign.** The patient signs no later than the tier's proposal validity counted from the proposal date. The validity is counted in calendar days starting the day after the proposal date, and a signature on the last day still qualifies. The proposal date is taken from the system record of the plan being signed.

**3. Withdrawal.** An unsigned proposal past its validity, or one the patient declines, is withdrawn and its enrolled charges return to standard statements.

**4. Down payment.** Any down payment is paid at signing as an extra payment of the kind down payment.

**5. First due date.** The first due date is the first occurrence of the chosen due day that is at least the tier's first-due spacing, in calendar days, after the signing date.

**6. Accounts in precollection.** Signing a plan that enrolls the past-due balance of an account in precollection returns that account to active under the financial account rules.

### Counting the validity period

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Event the count starts from | The proposal date of the plan |
| Unit | Calendar days |
| Day 1 of the count | The day after the proposal date |
| Last day | The day on which the count reaches the tier's proposal validity |
| Signature on the last day | Qualifies |
| Signature after the last day | Does not qualify; the unsigned proposal is withdrawn |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, validity of 14 days)

- Proposal dated 1 June: day 1 is 2 June and day 14 is 15 June. A signature on 15 June qualifies.
- The same proposal signed on 16 June is past the validity; it does not qualify, and the proposal is withdrawn.

### First due date (hypothetical)

A plan signed on 20 August with a chosen due day of the 5th and a first-due spacing of 30 calendar days: 30 days after signing is 19 September; the 5th of September falls before that date, so the first occurrence of the 5th at least 30 days after signing is 5 October, which is the first due date.
